description: Samsung is said to be nearing the end of its long-running One UI 8.5 beta cycle, following months of testing. According to a report, the stable update for the Samsung Galaxy S25 series could begin rolling out as early as this week. It is expected to be made available in select markets before expanding globally. The development builds upon the rollout of the One UI 8.5 beta update for Galaxy S24, Galaxy Z Fold 6, and select other models last month.
title: Samsung Galaxy S25 Series Likely to Begin Receiving Stable One UI 8.5 Update Soon: Report

description: Banking Circle has launched stablecoin settlement services after securing a CASP licence in Luxembourg. The offering enables fiat-to-stablecoin conversions for institutional clients, reflecting growing adoption of blockchain-based payment infrastructure within regulated financial systems.
title: Banking Circle Launches Stablecoin Settlement Services After Bagging CASP Licence

description: OnePlus Ace 6 Ultra will launch on April 28 in China. It will come with the MediaTek Dimensity 9500 chipset, 8,600mAh battery and 120W fast charging support. As the launch date is approaching, here is a quick overview of the launch details, expected price, specifications, and features of the phone.
title: OnePlus Ace 6 Ultra Roundup: Launch Date, Expected Price, Specifications

description: Vivo has launched the Vivo Y500s in China with a focus on battery life and durability. The phone features a 7200mAh battery, a 6.75-inch 120Hz display, and a Snapdragon 4 Gen 2 chipset. It offers up to 12GB RAM and 512GB storage, along with a 50-megapixel rear camera. The handset supports 44W fast charging, 5G connectivity, and runs Android 16-based OriginOS 6. It has been available in China since March 2026.
title: Vivo Y500s Launched With 7,200mAh Battery, 50-Megapixel Main Camera: Price, Spcifications

description: Qualcomm confirmed that the Snapdragon for India event will take place on May 7. The event is expected to include new announcements about new chipsets. OnePlus is also set to launch its Nord CE 6 series around the same time. The regular Nord CE 6 has already been confirmed to ship with the Snapdragon 7s Gen 4 SoC. Vivo will launch the Vivo X300 Ultra and Vivo X300 FE in India on May 6.
title: Qualcomm Sets Snapdragon for India Event for May 7 as OnePlus Gears Up for Nord CE 6 Launch

description: Jabra Evolve 2 75, the Danish company’s latest on-ear addition to its Evolve headphones lineup, recently launched in India. The new headphones retail in India for under Rs. 55,000, and are available for purchase via e-commerce platforms. Primarily targeting people who frequently attend online meetings or are perpetually on call, the Jabra Evolve 2 75 offers a great mix of decent audio quality and a premium build. The physical buttons are a great feature, even though most of the competition has moved to gesture-based navigation. Yet the reassuring tactile nature of physical buttons cannot be replaced.
title: Jabra Evolve 2 75 Review: Still the Best 'Bang for Your Buck' Office Headset?

description: HMD Vibe 2 5G will be launched in India in May, the smartphone maker confirmed on Monday. Additionally, a dedicated microsite for the upcoming smartphone has been made live on Flipkart, confirming its availability in the country via the e-commerce platform. The handset is shown to feature a flat display, which will sport a hole-punch display cutout, which might house a camera for selfies and video calls. The phone will succeed the HMD Vibe 5G, which was launched in India in September 2025. It features a 50-megapixel camera on the back.
title: HMD Vibe 2 5G India Launch Teased: Expected Design, Key Specifications

description: Renders of dummy units of Samsung Galaxy Z Fold 8, Galaxy Z Wide Fold, and Galaxy Z Flip 8 have been leaked online. The Galaxy Z Fold 8 and Galaxy Z Wide Fold appear to have the book-style foldable form factor. The Galaxy Z Fold 8 and Galaxy Z Flip 8 feature a similar design language to that of their predecessors. The renders suggest possible wireless charging support for the phones.
title: Samsung Galaxy Z Fold 8, Z Flip 8 and Z Wide Fold Dummy Units Hint at Design, Wireless Charging Support

description: Huawei may launch the Mate XT 2 tri-fold smartphone in October, according to a recent leak. The phone is tipped to feature a Kirin 9050 Pro chipset with a focus on AI performance. It could also include a battery larger than 6000mAh, an upgrade over its predecessor. The phone is expected to offer imaging similar to the Mate X7 series and may support stylus input. Improvements to the hinge design are also expected to reduce display creases and enhance durability.
title: Huawei Mate XT 2 Tipped to Launch in October With Upgraded Hinge, Kirin 9050 Pro Chip

description: Vivo Y600 Pro has been launched in China, the smartphone maker announced on Monday. Arriving as the latest addition to the tech firm's Y lineup, the Vivo Y600 Pro is set to go on sale in the country via the company's online store in four colour options. The new handset boasts a 10,200mAh battery. It is powered by an octa MediaTek Dimensity chipset. The phone has also been equipped with a dual rear camera unit, headlined by a 50-megapixel main shooter, housed inside a circular camera module, along with an LED flash.
title: Vivo Y600 Pro Launched With 10,200mAh Battery, 50-Megapixel Camera: Price, Specifications

description: Meta is now expanding its artificial intelligence (AI) tool for marketing campaigns to major global markets. Dubbed the Meta AI Business Assistant, it is a conversational AI platform designed to help advertisers optimise marketing campaigns, resolve account issues, and manage customer interactions across Meta's platforms. It was first introduced last year and was limited to select advertisers in the US.
title: Meta AI Business Assistant Expanded to Global Markets, to Let Advertisers Optimise Marketing Campaigns

description: Aave Labs has proposed that Arbitrum release $73.5 million in frozen ETH to support rsETH recovery following the Kelp DAO exploit. The funds would be directed to a joint recovery initiative aimed at restoring asset backing and compensating affected users across DeFi platforms.
title: Aave Labs Urges Arbitrum DAO to Release $73 Million in Frozen ETH for rsETH Recovery

description: The world’s first artificial intelligence (AI) store, which is entirely designed, managed, and run by an AI agent, is here. A San Francisco-based startup, Andon Labs, designed an AI agent with all the necessary tools required to run a physical store, and gave it the keys to a retail store and a corporate credit card with $100,000 (roughly Rs. 94.25 lakh) in the bank.
title: The $100,000 Experiment: What Happens When an AI Agent Manages a Store with Its Own Credit Card?

description: Elon Musk’s X has expanded its portfolio of apps with the launch of XChat. Currently available on iPhone and iPad, it is a standalone messaging app that builds on existing X networks. The company has positioned it as a privacy-focused solution, allowing users to connect with others without needing to exchange phone numbers or send invites. XChat, notably, marks a shift in the company’s broader strategy, which previously aimed to turn X into an all-in-one “everything app.”
title: XChat Launched for iPhone, iPad: What is It, Key Features and How the App Works

description: JBL has launched its Bar MK2 soundbar lineup in India, including the 1300MK2, 1000MK2, 800MK2, and 500MK2. The range supports Dolby Atmos, DTS, and MultiBeam 3.0, with output from 750W to 2,470W. Higher-end models feature detachable wireless surround speakers and up-firing drivers, while all models include SmartDetails and PureVoice 2.0. The lineup also supports streaming platforms, HDMI eARC, Bluetooth, and Wi-Fi connectivity, with prices starting at Rs. 64,999.
title: JBL Bar 1300MK2, 1000MK2, 800MK2, 500MK2 Soundbars Launched in India: Price, Features

description: Dell XPS 14 and Dell XPS 16 laptops have been refreshed in India. The new models feature a 70Whr battery alongside a 100W adapter. The Dell XPS 14 comes in Intel Core Ultra 7 355 and Intel Core Ultra X7 358H chipset options, while the XPS 16 runs on up to an Intel Core Ultra X7 358H processor. Both models run on Windows 11 Home and carry up to 32GB LPDDR5X RAM.
title: Dell XPS 14, Dell XPS 16 Refreshed With Up to Intel Core Ultra X7 358H CPU, Up to 16-Inch Displays: Price, Features

description: Apple's first foldable could be thicker than the Cupertino-based tech giant's flagship iPhone 17 Pro Max, according to the leaked internal diagrams of the smartphone. The handset is said to be 9.23mm thick in the folded state, which is marginally thicker than the iPhone 17 Pro Max's 8.75mm thickness. The camera module is shown to measure 4.46mm, which means that it could be approximately 13mm thick at its thickest point. The tech giant is expected to launch the new phone later this year, in September, along with the iPhone 18 Pro lineup.
title: Apple’s Foldable iPhone Will Be Slightly Thicker Than iPhone 17 Pro Max, Leaked Schematics Show

description: OnePlus Ace 6 Ultra will launch in China this week. Now, this model has been spotted on a Chinese telecom operator's website in 12GB+256GB, 16GB+256GB, 12GB+512GB, 16GB+512GB and 16GB+1TB RAM and storage options. The listing shows the phone with a  6.78-inch display, MediaTek Dimensity 9500 and a dual rear camera unit. It is listed with a 16-megapixel front-facing camera.
title: OnePlus Ace 6 Ultra Listed on China Telecom Database Along With Specifications Ahead of April 28 Launch

description: Samsung Galaxy Book 6 Edge has been listed on an e-commerce platform in Austria ahead of its official launch. The listing reveals various details about the upcoming Galaxy Book 6 series laptop, including its price, chipset, display, battery capacity, I/O ports, and other features. The laptop is listed with a 16-inch OLED display, delivering up to 120Hz of refresh rate. Unlike other models in the lineup, which are powered by Intel’s Panther Lake processors, the Galaxy Book 6 Edge could be equipped with Qualcomm’s Snapdragon X2 Elite chipset.
title: Samsung Galaxy Book 6 Edge Price, Key Specifications Listed by Retailer Ahead of Launch

description: OnePlus will launch two new fast chargers alongside the Ace 6 Ultra in China on April 28. The lineup includes a 120W Small Square Bottle dual-port charger and a 100W Small Square Bottle Pro model. The 120W variant supports up to 125W combined output and can charge the Ace 6 Ultra to 68 percent in 30 minutes. Both chargers use GaN technology, feature compact designs, and ship with upgraded soft silicone cables. The Pro model is designed to support both OnePlus and third-party devices.
title: OnePlus Confirms New 120W Dual-Port, 100W GaN Chargers Will Launch Alongside OnePlus Ace 6 Ultra

description: Assassin's Creed Codename Hexe has had yet another change of leadership. Game director Benoit Richer has left Ubisoft to join an independent studio, Servo Games. The development comes months after Assassin's Creed Hexe's creative director Clint Hocking departed Ubisoft.
title: Assassin's Creed Hexe Game Director Exits Ubisoft Months After Creative Director Left Project

description: OnePlus Nord CE 6 Lite will be launched in India on May 7 with a MediaTek Dimensity 7400 Apex chipset, the smartphone maker revealed on Monday. The handset will also be equipped with a display that will refresh at up to 144Hz. On top of this, the OnePlus Nord CE 6 Lite will be backed by a 7,000mAh battery, which is claimed to provide up to two days of battery life. The phone will also offer up to 144 fpa gameplay on specific titles, while delivering up to 90 fps gameplay on battle royale games. The OnePlus Nord CE 6 Lite will also ship with the latest Android 16-based OxygenOS 16.
title: OnePlus Nord CE 6 Lite Price Range, Chipset and Other Key Specifications Revealed as India Launch Draws Near

description: OpenAI is said to be moving towards building new custom processors for smartphones. According to an analyst, the San Francisco-based artificial intelligence (AI) company has partnered with MediaTek and Qualcomm, and both chipmakers are expected to benefit from long-term demand if smartphones with agentic AI capabilities gain traction. The project, however, is still believed to be in the infancy stage, with mass production currently targeted for 2028.
title: OpenAI Developing Custom Chips With MediaTek, Qualcomm for ‘AI Agent’ Smartphones: Ming-Chi Kuo

description: Bitcoin traded near $78,000 on Monday as steady ETF inflows and improving macro sentiment supported prices. Analysts say the market remains near key resistance, with $80,000 emerging as the next crucial level. Institutional demand continues to drive momentum, while investors await signals from the upcoming US Federal Reserve meeting.
title: Bitcoin Trades Near $78,000 as ETF Inflows and Macro Optimism Support Stabilising Cryptocurrency Prices

description: A recent leak suggests the Vivo X500 series may arrive in 6.4-inch and 6.9-inch display variants, with the larger model likely positioned as the Pro Max. The top-end version is reportedly being tested with a 50-megapixel LOFIC primary sensor designed to improve dynamic range. It could also feature a 200-megapixel periscope telephoto camera for enhanced zoom. Vivo is additionally said to be exploring a multispectral sensor, while a 50-megapixel ultra-wide camera may complete the setup.
title: Vivo X500 Pro Max Tipped to Launch With 200-Megapixel Periscope Telephoto Camera, 50-Megapixel LOFIC Camera

description: Apple’s incoming Chief Executive Officer (CEO), John Ternus, is said to take the reins of the Cupertino-based tech giant on September 1. In the latest edition of his ‘Power On’ newsletter, Bloomberg’s Mark Gurman writes that Tim Cook will be leaving Ternus with a strong product lineup, with multiple devices either in the development phase or awaiting launch. Moreover, Ternus will reportedly also be overseeing Apple’s entry into various new product categories. Soon after he takes charge, Apple will reportedly launch its first foldable smartphone, which could be called the iPhone Ultra.
title: Apple Said to Plan Launch of Foldable iPad, AI Smart Home Devices, Touchscreen MacBook Under John Ternus

description: MediaTek has released the Dimensity 7450 and Dimensity 7450X chipsets. They are octa-core processors with a CPU configuration of four Arm Cortex-A78 cores clocked up to 2.6GHz. They support Wi-Fi 6E and Bluetooth 5.4. The Dimensity 7450X is optimised for foldable phones. They feature MediaTek’s 6th-generation NPU and include MediaTek HyperEngine for improved gaming performance.
title: MediaTek Dimensity 7450 Chipset Unveiled Alongside Foldable-Ready Dimensity 7450X SoC

description: Developer Creative Assembly and Sega have finally shared a teaser for Alien: Isolation 2. The brief teaser doesn't give away any details, but features the phone booth save station from Alien: Isolation. The sequel was confirmed to be in early development in 2024.
title: Alien: Isolation 2 Gets Atmospheric Teaser From Creative Assembly and Sega

description: Sony has announced the latest round of price hikes for PlayStation 5 consoles and accessories in Southeast Asia. The move follows similar increases in North America, Europe, and Japan announced by the Japanese tech conglomerate earlier this month. As per Sony, the price hike affects the PS5, PS5 Pro, and other latest-generation gaming consoles, with continued global economic pressures cited as the primary reason behind the price revision.
title: Sony's PS5, PS5 Pro and PS Portal Get Price Hikes Across Southeast Asia; No Price Increase in India Yet

description: Microsoft’s planned transition to the new Windows Insider channels kicked off on Friday. Earlier this month, the Redmond-based tech giant acknowledged the confusing channel structure and the unreliable experience where, despite updating to a version mentioned in the changelog, Insiders might not see the new feature in the existing programme.
title: Microsoft Revamps Windows Insider Experience With New Beta and Experimental Channels

description: The 2026 foldable cycle has already begun with the launch of the Honor Magic V6 and Oppo Find N6 in China. Samsung is expected to introduce its latest book-style foldable phone globally, along with a wide-folding model, later this year. A tipster has now shared key details about the foldable phones from Vivo and Xiaomi, which may debut as the Vivo X Fold 6 and the Xiaomi Mix Fold 6, respectively.
title: Vivo X Fold 6 Could Feature 200-Megapixel Camera, Large Battery; Xiaomi Mix Fold 6 Launch Timeline Tipped

description: Xiaomi is said to be preparing to expand its smartphone lineup with new sub-flagship models, following the launch of the flagship Xiaomi 17 series in India and the global markets earlier this year. The upcoming lineup is expected to include two handsets — Xiaomi 17T and Xiaomi 17T Pro. While the company has yet to confirm the smartphones, the vanilla model has now surfaced on a benchmarking site, hinting at its chipset, RAM, and software details.
title: Xiaomi 17T With Dimensity 8500 Chip, 12GB of RAM Surfaces on Geekbench Ahead of Launch
